cv_node_types.label: Attitude
cv_node_types.comment: Attitude is a tendency to act (or feel) in a given situation (Maze, 2011) inherent to an individual, based on assumptions, values, and beliefs (Maze, 2011). cv_node_types.label: Evidence
cv_node_types.comment: Any object (social or not) used to prove a human capability.

cv_node_types.label: HumanQuality
cv_node_types.comment: Qualities inherent to a person, e.g. age, gender, height, etc.

cv_node_types.label: HumanTask
cv_node_types.comment: Event performed by a person as a result of the manifestation of his/her human capabilities

cv_node_types.label: HumanTrait
cv_node_types.comment: Traits inherent to an individual, e.g. John's introversion, Paul's interest, Mary's hobbies

cv_node_types.label: Knowledge
cv_node_types.comment: Knowledge is typically associated with internal representations of facts, principles, or theories (WESTERA, 2001) by an individual. and that can be manifested through actions.

cv_node_types.label: Person
cv_node_types.comment: Physical agent that are human being

cv_node_types.label: PersonalCompetence
cv_node_types.comment: Competence is a human capability inherent to an individual and formed by the combination of perceptible characteristics, such as the ``well-known'' knowledge, skills, and attitudes (KSA) elements.

cv_node_types.label: Proficiency
cv_node_types.comment: Intencity or deepness of a human capability. Can be related to level, degree, score, or other quality.

cv_node_types.label: Resource
cv_node_types.comment: Any object used in a task by a person as manifestation of a human capability

cv_node_types.label: Skill
cv_node_types.comment: Skill is a human capability of an individual to perform a task (discrete unit of work) well (RODRIGUES et al, 2021), not strongly related to a context.

cv_node_types.label: TaskInput
cv_node_types.comment: Artifact used in a task as manifestation of a human capability

cv_node_types.label: TaskOutput
cv_node_types.comment: Artifact created or changed in a task as manifestation of a human capability

jd_node_types.label: ArtifactType
jd_node_types.comment: A job requirement specifying a needed Artifact (tool, document, or deliverable). Artifact used in a task as manifestation of a human capability / Artifact created or changed in a task as manifestation of a human capability

jd_node_types.label: KnowledgeType
jd_node_types.comment: A job requirement specifying a needed Knowledge area. Knowledge is typically associated with internal representations of facts, principles, or theories (WESTERA, 2001) by an individual. and that can be manifested through actions.

jd_node_types.label: ResourceType
jd_node_types.comment: A job requirement specifying a needed Resource. Any object used in a task by a person as manifestation of a human capability

jd_node_types.label: SkillType
jd_node_types.comment: A job requirement specifying a needed Skill. Skill is a human capability of an individual to perform a task (discrete unit of work) well (RODRIGUES et al, 2021), not strongly related to a context.

jd_node_types.label: TaskType
jd_node_types.comment: A job requirement specifying a needed Task. Event performed by a person as a result of the manifestation of his/her human capabilities
